mechanism: Additional non-electoral heat-pump permitting research and technical implementation support; count earlier actual gas-to-electric conversions, not permits or whole legislation
unit: Hypothetical additional USD100000 program grant; no restricted offer verified
geography: Only health of San Francisco residents, even when regional implementation generates it
formula: netQalys = fraction * realization * contribution * effectiveYears * sfShare * deaths * qalysPerDeath - harm

inputDefinitions.fraction: Judgment: equivalent fraction of full regional modeled appliance exposure reduction brought forward by the whole prospective implementation package conditional on success; net of funded/required baseline, not percent permit growth
inputDefinitions.realization: Judgment probability prospective package changes actual conversion timing/uptake rather than documentation only
inputDefinitions.contribution: Judgment marginal gift's causal contribution to package, including replacement of existing SPUR funds and other actors; not SPUR's historical share of laws
inputDefinitions.effectiveYears: Judgment equivalent discounted steady-state mortality-impact years, accounting for adoption ramp, actual earlier-exposure window, mortality lag and calendar discounting; not equipment lifetime
inputDefinitions.sfShare: Judgment fraction of modeled health gains accruing to SF residents; not organization address or population share assumed factual
inputDefinitions.deaths: Primary modeled 37–85 annual deaths for full regional appliance emissions elimination, not randomized outcomes;61 midpoint judgment
inputDefinitions.qalysPerDeath: Judgment discounted remaining health-years per mortality case, valued at case time; calendar timing handled only in effectiveYears
inputDefinitions.harm: Already-net SF QALY burden attributable to the grant, adjusted for its own implementation/additionality pathway; raw harm per installation requires that adjustment first. Identical replacement funding has no shared installation-harm increment; donor-specific harms can persist. Zero central means unquantified, not proven absent

sources.nativeEndpoint: 37–85 modeled annual premature deaths averted if total PM2.5 reductions from full regional equipment emissions elimination occur
sources.causalLimit: No donor/program causal effect; epidemiological model range, not SPUR CI

resourceBoundary.omitted: Net city/contractor implementation resources; incremental equipment/electrical work, operation, maintenance and disposal relative to otherwise scheduled replacement; financing/incidence and harms. No energy/healthcare savings credited.
resourceBoundary.cautions: Fees/taxes/rebates are transfers, not synonymous with net resources. Do not add full replacement cost if comparator buys replacement anyway.

currentRuleBaseline.finding: July14,2026 draft flexibility amendments, August13 comment deadline, tentative November boarddecision; existing public technical guidance and implementation working group are baseline, not donor-added outcomes
currentRuleBaseline.pollutantBoundary: 37–85 total-PM mortality requires actual gas-to-electric combustion-emission removal; hypothetical zero-NOx gas equipment cannot inherit primary-PM benefit automatically
